title: WRCC2023_MI_A: WRCC2023 MI-A three-class motor imagery dataset
description: Three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (left hand, right hand, feet) from the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition (MI-A track). It contains 59-channel, 1000 Hz recordings from 9 participants, two of whom are stroke patients, with 90 cued 4 s imagery trials per subject (30 per class). This BIDS version was generated with MOABB from the Harvard Dataverse source deposit and includes HED event annotations.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels, 10-10 montage, 1000 Hz sampling rate). Participants performed cue-based, offline motor imagery of left-hand grasping, right-hand grasping, and foot hooking, with no feedback. Each of the 90 trials per subject was stored as a 4 s epoch and exposed as a separate run.
